$comment: What a coach would sign off on. Ranges wherever the planner may legitimately vary. See ../README.md#golden-plan-format-assert-properties-not-bytes

prescription.runWalkStructureExample: 6 × (90s run / 60s walk) — intervals are intensity-light, density-forward

constraintRespect.conflictHandling: shift or drop only — must NOT create a make-up session on 2027-01-17 or inflate that week above the ramp ceiling

painAwareness.$comment: Grade-2 lateral knee pain during running, resolves next morning: not a hard stop, but it must show up in the plan.

taper.$comment: A novice 5K goal does not need a taper; the final week simply trims volume and keeps one short sharp-ish session.

openQuestionsMustInclude: no pace or HR data — how do we know the easy effort is easy? (asks for a talk-test or a 6-min test)
goal date gives 13–14 weeks with only 3 measured weeks of history — confirm 3 days/week is stable
expectedPlanVersionHashNote: Recorded separately in expect.hash for silent-change detection only.
